author: ProfessorUtonium
body:
Why put -1 without an explanation why you don't like it?

I've seen players put just -1 with no details on WHY it's bad on my maps.
When you put -1 on maps why not explain how to make it better

In map submissions all players put -1. Whenever I submit a map it's a -1. Which is all they put. If you say the map is bad why not just do:
-1 -Explanation- -Your opinion on how to make it better-

For +1 say how you would improve it a bit more and what not

P|3as3
